issues.description: WIN-053.c12 H0: Paragraph invokes "monopole pair" as label for e^(−r/λ) functional form. Textbook magnetic-monopole field has Coulomb-like 1/r² spatial dependence, not exponential decay. "Monopole pair" is topologically correct (two same-signed sources, no sink) but conflates sign structure with spatial form. A pedantic defender could argue exp(−r/λ) is not the field of a monopole pair. Curmudgeon notes existing text is operationally correct; optional one-clause clarification to specify the topological meaning. Severity minor; no attack surface opened.
